pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with smooth pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp transitions. Patch spatial area is highest on the neck and upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the posterior and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous topological network of pathways. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-section, with high continuity throughout the visible region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serration, creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the out-of-focus background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A minor structural break or localized thinning in the mane line is visible at the transition point between the lower neck and the apex of the shoulder.
